item.title: Comment on Call For Action To Solve ‘Awful’ Traffic Situation At Junction by Patrick Henry
item.description: They should either make it into a roundabout,or change the light sequence to the uk system,in the uk when light is red and about to go green the amber light comes on ,our system goes red to green and there’s a delay while the first car gets into gear and moves,with the uk system you’d get at least three more cars through.

item.title: Comment on Cllr Calls For Plant Boxes To Enhance Greenery In The Square by Mary Sharp
item.description: The Square and all the footpaths especially passed Pamela Scott and down passed Guineys are a disgrace. They are never washed. The council have a washer machine but you very rarely see it in operation. Flower boxes and a few trees would make such a difference..
